_description: Test inputs for BHR contractor onboarding. Edit contractor details, country assignments, or sanctioned country list, then run: npm start

PRT.notes: Standard EU country. CM, CM+, COR all expected with eligible entity.

GBR.notes: UK contractor. IR35 applies. In 30-country list but same-country COR blocked.

BHR.notes: No COR support. Only CM/CM+ available with eligible entity.

USA.notes: Used for same-country COR test (B5). COR blocked when entity = contractor country.

DEU.notes: EU country for same-country COR test (B4). COR blocked when entity = contractor country.

IND.notes: Outside 30-country list. No CM/CM+ with India entity. EOR fallback path.

test_roles._description: Maps each test scenario to a country code from the contractors section above.
